scene_description: A cleared grass platform with a cluster of birch logs (7 logs in an L-shape, 4-high + 3-high columns) at ~4,0,4 and a 2x2x2 cube of red nether bricks at ~8,0,5. The player spawns with a crafting table in their inventory. The player must first mine birch logs to craft planks, sticks, and a wooden pickaxe (using the crafting table), then use the pickaxe to mine red nether bricks. Red nether bricks require at least a wooden pickaxe to drop as an item — breaking by hand yields nothing. This creates a genuine hard dependency chain.
task_text: First, mine some birch logs nearby. Use the crafting table in your inventory to craft a wooden pickaxe from the birch wood. Then find and mine the red nether bricks.
design_notes: Birch logs at ~4,0,4 (4-high) and ~5,0,4 (3-high) form an L-shape — 7 logs total, more than enough for a wooden pickaxe (need 2 logs minimum: 2 logs → 8 planks → 3 planks + 2 sticks = 1 pickaxe). Red nether bricks form a 2x2x2 cube at ~8-9,0-1,5-6 — 8 blocks total, providing multiple mining targets. The dark red color contrasts well against the green grass and white birch. The area is cleared 8 blocks in all directions from spawn to prevent natural tree interference. Both targets are within 4-8 blocks of spawn on a flat platform.
